171: ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਇਆ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ; ਹਰਿ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਦੀਆ. ਮਨੁ ਠਾਢੇ ॥੧॥
By great good fortune I have found the Perfect Guru; He has given me the Lord's mantra, and my mind is at peace. ॥1॥
ਰਾਮ ਹਮ; ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਲਾਲੇ ਕਾਂਢੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
O Lord, I am called the slave of the True Guru. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਹਮਰੈ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਦਾਗੁ ਦਗਾਨਾ; ਹਮ ਕਰਜ ਗੁਰੂ ਬਹੁ ਸਾਢੇ ॥
My forehead has been branded with the mark (of His slave); I owe the Guru so great a debt.
ਪਰਉਪਕਾਰੁ. ਪੁੰਨੁ ਬਹੁ ਕੀਆ; ਭਉ ਦੁਤਰੁ ਤਾਰਿ ਪਰਾਢੇ ॥੨॥
He has been so generous and kind to me; He has carried me across the terrifying, treacherous world-ocean. ॥2॥
ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਰਿਦੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਹੀ; ਤਿਨ ਕੂਰੇ ਗਾਢਨ ਗਾਢੇ ॥
Those who have no love for the Lord in their hearts make only false ties.
ਜਿਉ ਪਾਣੀ ਕਾਗਦੁ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਜਾਤ ਹੈ; ਤਿਉ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਗਰਭਿ ਗਲਾਢੇ ॥੩॥
As paper dissolves in water, so the self-willed rot away in the womb. ॥3॥
ਹਮ ਜਾਨਿਆ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਨਹ ਆਗੈ; ਜਿਉ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖੈ ਤਿਉ ਠਾਢੇ ॥
I knew nothing, and I know nothing of the future; as the Lord keeps me, so I stand.
ਹਮ ਭੂਲ ਚੂਕ ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰਹੁ; ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੁਤਰੇ ਕਾਢੇ ॥੪॥੭॥੨੧॥੫੯॥
O Guru, be merciful despite my mistakes and shortcomings; servant Nanak is called Your dog. ॥4॥7॥21॥59॥
ਕਾਮਿ ਕਰੋਧਿ ਨਗਰੁ ਬਹੁ ਭਰਿਆ; ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਖੰਡਲ ਖੰਡਾ ਹੇ ॥
The body-village is filled to overflowing with lust and anger; meeting the Holy Guru, they are shattered to pieces.
ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਤ ਲਿਖੇ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ; ਮਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਮੰਡਲ ਮੰਡਾ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
By pre-ordained destiny, I have met the Guru; my mind is adorned with the light of love for the Lord. ॥1॥
ਕਰਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਅੰਜੁਲੀ; ਪੁੰਨੁ ਵਡਾ ਹੇ ॥
Greet the Holy Guru with palms pressed together; this is a great good deed.
ਕਰਿ ਡੰਡਉਤ; ਪੁਨੁ ਵਡਾ ਹੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Bow down before Him; this is a great good deed. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਸਾਕਤ. ਹਰਿ ਰਸ ਸਾਦੁ. ਨ ਜਾਨਿਆ; ਤਿਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ. ਹਉਮੈ ਕੰਡਾ ਹੇ ॥
The faithless cynics do not know the taste of the Lord's essence; the thorn of ego is within them.
ਜਿਉ ਜਿਉ ਚਲਹਿ. ਚੁਭੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ; ਜਮਕਾਲੁ. ਸਹਹਿ ਸਿਰਿ ਡੰਡਾ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
The more they walk, the more it pricks, and they suffer in pain; they bear the blow of Death's club on their heads. ॥2॥
ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਣੇ; ਦੁਖੁ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਭਵ ਖੰਡਾ ਹੇ ॥
The Lord's humble servants are absorbed in the Name of the Lord, Har, Har; the pain of birth and death and the fear of the world are destroyed.
ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ; ਬਹੁ ਸੋਭ ਖੰਡ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਡਾ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
They have found the imperishable, all-pervading Transcendent Lord, and receive great honour throughout all the worlds and realms. ॥3॥
ਹਮ ਗਰੀਬ ਮਸਕੀਨ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇਰੇ; ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖੁ ਰਾਖੁ ਵਡ ਵਡਾ ਹੇ ॥
I am poor and humble, O God, but I am Yours; save me, save me, O greatest of the great Lord.
ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ. ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ਟੇਕ ਹੈ; ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੇ ਹੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਮੰਡਾ ਹੇ ॥੪॥੮॥੨੨॥੬੦॥
Servant Nanak takes the Name as his sustenance and support; in the Lord's Name alone he enjoys peace. ॥4॥8॥22॥60॥
ਇਸੁ ਗੜ ਮਹਿ. ਹਰਿ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਇ ਹੈ; ਕਿਛੁ ਸਾਦੁ. ਨ ਪਾਵੈ. ਧੀਠਾ ॥
Within this fortress of the body is the Lord, the Sovereign King, but the stubborn one does not taste His delight.
ਹਰਿ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲਿ. ਅਨੁਗ੍ਰਹੁ ਕੀਆ; ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ. ਚਖਿ ਡੀਠਾ ॥੧॥
When the Lord, merciful to the meek, showed His mercy, I tasted and savoured it through the Guru's Word. ॥1॥
ਰਾਮ. ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ; ਗੁਰ ਲਿਵ ਮੀਠਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
O Lord, singing the Lord's praises, attuned to the Guru, is sweet. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਹਰਿ ਅਗਮੁ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਹੈ; ਮਿਲਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਲਾਗਿ ਬਸੀਠਾ ॥
The Lord is inaccessible, unfathomable, the Supreme Lord God; He is met by meeting the True Guru, the advocate.
ਜਿਨ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨ ਸੁਖਾਨੇ ਹੀਅਰੈ; ਤਿਨ ਆਗੈ ਆਣਿ ਪਰੀਠਾ ॥੨॥
Before those whose hearts love the Guru's words, He brings and serves (the Lord's nectar). ॥2॥
ਮਨਮੁਖ ਹੀਅਰਾ. ਅਤਿ ਕਠੋਰੁ ਹੈ; ਤਿਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਕਾਰ ਕਰੀਠਾ ॥
The hearts of the self-willed are very hard; within them is blackness.
ਬਿਸੀਅਰ ਕਉ. ਬਹੁ ਦੂਧੁ ਪੀਆਈਐ; ਬਿਖੁ ਨਿਕਸੈ ਫੋਲਿ ਫੁਲੀਠਾ ॥੩॥
One may feed a snake plenty of milk, but if you examine it, only poison comes out. ॥3॥
ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਆਨਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਹੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਾਧੂ; ਘਸਿ ਗਰੁੜੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਲੀਠਾ ॥
O Lord God, bring me to meet the Holy Guru, that I may take the Word in my mouth like the antidote rubbed (for snakebite).
ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ. ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਲਾਲੇ ਗੋਲੇ; ਲਗਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ. ਕਰੂਆ ਮੀਠਾ ॥੪॥੯॥੨੩॥੬੧॥
Servant Nanak is the slave and servant of the Guru; joining His company, the bitter becomes sweet. ॥4॥9॥23॥61॥
ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਅਰਥਿ. ਸਰੀਰੁ ਹਮ ਬੇਚਿਆ; ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਆਗੇ ॥
For the sake of the Lord, Har, Har, I have sold my body to the Perfect Guru.
ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਦਾਤੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਦਿੜਾਇਆ; ਮੁਖਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਭਾਗ ਸਭਾਗੇ ॥੧॥
The True Guru, the Giver, has implanted the Name within me; good destiny is written on my face and forehead. ॥1॥
ਰਾਮ; ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
O Lord, through the Guru's teaching, one is lovingly attuned to the Lord. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
172: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਰਮਈਆ ਰਮਤ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਇ; ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਗੁਰੂ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੇ ॥
The beautiful Lord King pervades each and every heart; through the Guru's Word, one is lovingly attuned to Him.
ਹਉ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਦੇਵਉ ਕਾਟਿ ਗੁਰੂ ਕਉ; ਮੇਰਾ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਭਉ. ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੀ ਭਾਗੇ ॥੨॥
I would cut off my mind and body and give them to the Guru; through the Guru's words, my doubt and fear have run away. ॥2॥
ਅੰਧਿਆਰੈ. ਦੀਪਕ ਆਨਿ ਜਲਾਏ; ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨਿ. ਗੁਰੂ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੇ ॥
In the darkness, the Guru has brought and lit the lamp; through the Guru's spiritual wisdom, one is lovingly attuned to Him.
ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ਅੰਧੇਰਾ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਬਿਨਾਸਿਓ; ਘਰਿ ਵਸਤੁ ਲਹੀ. ਮਨ ਜਾਗੇ ॥੩॥
The darkness of ignorance is completely dispelled; one finds the treasure in one's own home, and the mind awakens. ॥3॥
ਸਾਕਤ ਬਧਿਕ ਮਾਇਆਧਾਰੀ; ਤਿਨ. ਜਮ ਜੋਹਨਿ ਲਾਗੇ ॥
The faithless cynics are cruel hunters, devoted to Maya; the Messenger of Death keeps them in his sight.
ਉਨ. ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਆਗੈ, ਸੀਸੁ ਨ ਬੇਚਿਆ; ਓਇ ਆਵਹਿ ਜਾਹਿ ਅਭਾਗੇ ॥੪॥
They have not sold their heads to the True Guru; those unfortunate ones keep coming and going. ॥4॥
ਹਮਰਾ ਬਿਨਉ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਠਾਕੁਰ; ਹਮ ਸਰਣਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਹਰਿ ਮਾਗੇ ॥
Hear my prayer, O God, my Lord and Master: I seek Your sanctuary, O Lord God, and beg for Your Name.
ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ. ਲਜ ਪਾਤਿ ਗੁਰੂ ਹੈ; ਸਿਰੁ ਬੇਚਿਓ. ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਆਗੇ ॥੫॥੧੦॥੨੪॥੬੨॥
The Guru is the honour and respect of servant Nanak; he has sold his head to the True Guru. ॥5॥10॥24॥62॥
ਹਮ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੀ. ਅਹੰਕਾਰ ਅਗਿਆਨ ਮਤਿ; ਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ. ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
I was egotistical, with an intellect of ego and ignorance; meeting the Guru, my self-conceit has been dispelled.
ਹਉਮੈ ਰੋਗੁ ਗਇਆ. ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ; ਧਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
The disease of ego is gone, and I have found peace; blessed, blessed is the Guru, the Lord King. ॥1॥
ਰਾਮ; ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
O Lord, through the Guru's Word I have found the Lord. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਮੇਰੈ ਹੀਅਰੈ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਇ ਕੀ; ਗੁਰਿ. ਮਾਰਗੁ ਪੰਥੁ ਬਤਾਇਆ ॥
In my heart is love for the Lord King; the Guru has shown me the path and the way.
ਮੇਰਾ ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਸਭੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਆਗੈ; ਜਿਨਿ ਵਿਛੁੜਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਗਲਿ ਲਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
My soul and body are all offered to the True Guru, who has embraced me, separated as I was, and united me with the Lord. ॥2॥
ਮੇਰੈ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਗੀ ਦੇਖਨ ਕਉ; ਗੁਰਿ. ਹਿਰਦੇ ਨਾਲਿ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ॥
Within me was the longing to behold Him; the Guru has shown Him to me, within my own heart.
ਸਹਜ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਭਇਆ ਮਨਿ ਮੋਰੈ; ਗੁਰ ਆਗੈ ਆਪੁ ਵੇਚਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
Poise and bliss have welled up in my mind; I have sold myself to the Guru. ॥3॥
ਹਮ ਅਪਰਾਧ ਪਾਪ ਬਹੁ ਕੀਨੇ; ਕਰਿ ਦੁਸਟੀ ਚੋਰ ਚੁਰਾਇਆ ॥
I have committed so many sins and crimes; I did evil and hid it, as a thief hides what he has stolen.
ਅਬ ਨਾਨਕ. ਸਰਣਾਗਤਿ ਆਏ; ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਲਾਜ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੧੧॥੨੫॥੬੩॥
Now Nanak has come to Your sanctuary; O Lord, preserve my honour, as it pleases You. ॥4॥11॥25॥63॥
ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਬਾਜੈ. ਸਬਦੁ ਅਨਾਹਦੁ; ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਮਨੂਆ ਗਾਵੈ ॥
Through the Guru's teaching, the unstruck melody of the Word resounds; through the Guru's teaching, the mind sings (His praises).
ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਗੁਰ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ; ਧਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
By great good fortune I have obtained the Guru's Blessed Vision; blessed, blessed is the Guru, who lovingly attunes one to the Lord. ॥1॥
Facing the Guru, one is lovingly attuned to the Lord. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਹਮਰਾ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ; ਮਨੁ. ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵੈ ॥
My Lord and Master is the Perfect True Guru; my mind does the work the Guru gives.
ਹਮ ਮਲਿ ਮਲਿ ਧੋਵਹ ਪਾਵ ਗੁਰੂ ਕੇ; ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਥਾ ਸੁਨਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
I massage and wash the feet of the Guru, who recites to me the discourse of the Lord, Har, Har. ॥2॥
ਹਿਰਦੈ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਰਾਮ ਰਸਾਇਣੁ; ਜਿਹਵਾ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ॥
Through the Guru's teaching, the Lord's Name, the source of all delight, is in their hearts, and their tongues sing the Lord's praises.
ਮਨ ਰਸਕਿ ਰਸਕਿ. ਹਰਿ ਰਸਿ ਆਘਾਨੇ; ਫਿਰਿ ਬਹੁਰਿ. ਨ ਭੂਖ ਲਗਾਵੈ ॥੩॥
Their minds, savouring and savouring, are satisfied with the Lord's essence; they are never hungry again. ॥3॥
ਕੋਈ ਕਰੈ ਉਪਾਵ. ਅਨੇਕ ਬਹੁਤੇਰੇ; ਬਿਨੁ ਕਿਰਪਾ. ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
One may try all sorts of things, but without His grace the Name is not obtained.
ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ. ਹਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ; ਮਤਿ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਵੈ ॥੪॥੧੨॥੨੬॥੬੪॥
The Lord has shown mercy to servant Nanak; through the Guru's teaching He has implanted the Name in his mind. ॥4॥12॥26॥64॥
O my soul, facing the Guru, chant the Name; your good fortune (has awakened).
ਮਤਿ ਮਾਤਾ. ਮਤਿ ਜੀਉ; ਨਾਮੁ ਮੁਖਿ. ਰਾਮਾ ॥
Make wisdom your mother and your very life; chant the Lord's Name with your mouth.
ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਪਿਤਾ ਕਰਿ; ਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਅਜਨਮਾ ॥
Make contentment your father, (and take refuge in) the Guru, the Unborn Lord.
173: By great good fortune, meet the Lord. ॥1॥
ਗੁਰੁ ਜੋਗੀ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ; ਰੰਗੁ ਮਾਣੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
I have met the Guru, the yogi, the divine Being; I enjoy His love.
ਗੁਰੁ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਤੜਾ; ਸਦਾ ਨਿਰਬਾਣੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
The Guru is imbued with the Lord's love, and is ever free of desire.
By great good fortune, meet Him, the most accomplished and all-knowing.
ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ; ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਭਿੰਨਾ ॥੨॥
My mind and body are drenched in the Lord's love. ॥2॥
Come, O saints, let us join together and chant the Name.
ਵਿਚਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ; ਨਾਮੁ ਸਦਾ ਲੈ ਲਾਹਾ ਜੀਉ ॥
In the holy company, earn forever the profit of the Name.
ਕਰਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਸੰਤਾ; ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਹਾ ਜੀਉ ॥
Let us serve the saints and place the ambrosial nectar in our mouths.
Meet Him, (O my soul,) by the destiny written from the beginning. ॥3॥
ਸਾਵਣਿ ਵਰਸੁ; ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਜਗੁ ਛਾਇਆ ਜੀਉ ॥
As the cloud rains in the month of Saavan and covers the world with water,
ਮਨੁ ਮੋਰੁ. ਕੁਹੁਕਿਅੜਾ; ਸਬਦੁ. ਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
the peacock of the mind cries out in joy, and takes the Word into its mouth.
ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਵੁਠੜਾ; ਮਿਲਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇਆ ਜੀਉ ॥
The Lord's ambrosial nectar has rained down, and I have met the Lord King.
Servant Nanak is imbued with His love. ॥4॥1॥27॥65॥
ਆਉ ਸਖੀ; ਗੁਣ ਕਾਮਣ ਕਰੀਹਾ ਜੀਉ ॥
Come, my friends, let us make our virtues the charms (to win the Husband Lord).
ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ; ਰੰਗੁ ਮਾਣਿਹ ਰਲੀਆ ਜੀਉ ॥
Joining the holy, let us enjoy the pleasure of His love.
ਗੁਰ ਦੀਪਕੁ ਗਿਆਨੁ; ਸਦਾ ਮਨਿ ਬਲੀਆ ਜੀਉ ॥
Let the lamp of the Guru's spiritual wisdom burn forever in the mind.
ਹਰਿ ਤੁਠੈ; ਢੁਲਿ ਢੁਲਿ ਮਿਲੀਆ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
When the Lord is pleased, we bow and bow in gratitude and meet Him. ॥1॥
ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮੁ ਲਗਾ; ਹਰਿ ਢੋਲੇ ਜੀਉ ॥
My mind and body are filled with love for my Beloved Lord.
ਮੈ ਮੇਲੇ ਮਿਤ੍ਰੁ; ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਵੇਚੋਲੇ ਜੀਉ ॥
May the True Guru, the go-between, unite me with my Friend.
ਮਨੁ ਦੇਵਾਂ ਸੰਤਾ; ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਲੇ ਜੀਉ ॥
I would give my mind to the saints who would unite me with my God.
I am forever a sacrifice to the Lord. ॥2॥
ਵਸੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਿਆਰਿਆ. ਵਸੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿਦਾ; ਹਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ. ਮਨਿ ਵਸੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
Dwell, O my Beloved; dwell, O my Lord of the Universe; O Lord, be merciful and dwell in my mind.
ਮਨਿ ਚਿੰਦਿਅੜਾ. ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ; ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਵੇਖਿ ਵਿਗਸੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
I have obtained the fruit of my mind's desires, O my Lord of the Universe; beholding the Perfect Guru, I blossom forth.
ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ. ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ; ਮਨਿ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਅਨਦੁ ਰਹਸੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
The happy soul-brides receive the Lord's Name, O my Lord of the Universe; night and day their minds are blissful and joyous.
ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਅੜਾ ਵਡਭਾਗੀਈ. ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ; ਨਿਤ ਲੈ ਲਾਹਾ. ਮਨਿ ਹਸੁ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
By great good fortune they have found the Lord, O my Lord of the Universe; earning the profit every day, their minds rejoice. ॥3॥
ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਉਪਾਏ. ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਵੇਖੈ; ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਕਾਰੈ ਲਾਇਆ ਜੀਉ ॥
The Lord Himself creates, the Lord Himself beholds, and the Lord Himself assigns all to their tasks.
ਇਕਿ ਖਾਵਹਿ ਬਖਸ. ਤੋਟਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ; ਇਕਨਾ. ਫਕਾ ਪਾਇਆ ਜੀਉ ॥
Some partake of His bounty, which never runs short, while others receive only a handful.
ਇਕਿ ਰਾਜੇ. ਤਖਤਿ ਬਹਹਿ ਨਿਤ ਸੁਖੀਏ; ਇਕਨਾ. ਭਿਖ ਮੰਗਾਇਆ ਜੀਉ ॥
Some are kings, seated on thrones, ever at ease, while others He makes beg for alms.
ਸਭੁ ਇਕੋ ਸਬਦੁ ਵਰਤਦਾ. ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿਦਾ; ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ. ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੨॥੨੮॥੬੬॥
Your one Word pervades everywhere, O my Lord of the Universe; servant Nanak meditates on the Name. ॥4॥2॥28॥66॥
ਮਨ ਮਾਹੀ. ਮਨ ਮਾਹੀ, ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ; ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਤਾ. ਮਨ ਮਾਹੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
Within the mind, within the mind, O my Lord of the Universe, one is dyed in the Lord's love within the mind.
ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਨਾਲਿ. ਨ ਲਖੀਐ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿਦਾ; ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ. ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਹੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
The Lord's love is with us, but cannot be seen, O my Lord of the Universe; the Perfect Guru shows us the unseen Lord.
ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਰਗਾਸਿਆ. ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ; ਸਭ ਦਾਲਦ ਦੁਖ. ਲਹਿ ਜਾਹੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
When the Lord's Name, Har, Har, is revealed, O my Lord of the Universe, all poverty and pain depart.
ਹਰਿ ਪਦੁ ਊਤਮੁ ਪਾਇਆ. ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ; ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਹੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
Those who attain the sublime state of the Lord, O my Lord of the Universe — those fortunate ones merge in the Name. ॥1॥
ਨੈਣੀ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਿਆਰਿਆ. ਨੈਣੀ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿਦਾ; ਕਿਨੈ. ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਡਿਠੜਾ ਨੈਣੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
With the eyes, O my Beloved, with the eyes, O my Lord of the Universe — has anyone seen the Lord God with these eyes?
ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਬੈਰਾਗਿਆ. ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ; ਹਰਿ ਬਾਝਹੁ. ਧਨ ਕੁਮਲੈਣੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
My mind and body are so sad and detached, O my Lord of the Universe; without the Lord, the soul-bride is withering away.
174: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਮਿਲਿ ਪਾਇਆ. ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿਦਾ; ਮੇਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਜਣੁ ਸੈਣੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
Meeting the holy, I have found, O my Lord of the Universe, my Lord God, my Companion and best Friend.
ਹਰਿ ਆਇ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ. ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ; ਮੈ ਸੁਖਿ ਵਿਹਾਣੀ. ਰੈਣੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
The Lord, the Life of the world, has come to meet me, O my Lord of the Universe; the night of my life now passes in peace. ॥2॥
ਮੈ ਮੇਲਹੁ ਸੰਤ. ਮੇਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਜਣੁ; ਮੈ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਭੁਖ ਲਗਾਈਆ ਜੀਉ ॥
O saints, unite me with my Lord God, my Friend; my mind and body hunger for Him.
ਹਉ. ਰਹਿ ਨ ਸਕਉ, ਬਿਨੁ ਦੇਖੇ ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ; ਮੈ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਿਰਹੁ. ਹਰਿ ਲਾਈਆ ਜੀਉ ॥
I cannot live without seeing my Beloved; deep within me, I feel the pain of separation from the Lord.
ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇਆ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਜਣੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ; ਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲੇ. ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਜੀਵਾਈਆ ਜੀਉ ॥
The Lord King is my beloved Friend; when the Guru unites me with Him, my mind is revived.
ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਆਸਾ ਪੂਰੀਆ. ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ; ਹਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਮਨਿ ਵਾਧਾਈਆ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
The hopes of my mind and body are fulfilled, O my Lord of the Universe; meeting the Lord, my mind rejoices. ॥3॥
ਵਾਰੀ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ. ਵਾਰੀ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਿਆਰਿਆ; ਹਉ ਤੁਧੁ ਵਿਟੜਿਅਹੁ. ਸਦ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
A sacrifice, O my Lord of the Universe, a sacrifice, O my Beloved — I am forever a sacrifice to You.
ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮੁ ਪਿਰੰਮ ਕਾ. ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿਦਾ; ਹਰਿ ਪੂੰਜੀ ਰਾਖੁ. ਹਮਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
My mind and body are filled with love for my Husband Lord, O my Lord of the Universe; O Lord, preserve this capital of mine.
ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਵਿਸਟੁ ਮੇਲਿ. ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ; ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲੇ. ਕਰਿ ਰੈਬਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
Unite me with the True Guru, the go-between, O my Lord of the Universe, who, guiding me, will unite me with the Lord.
ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦਇਆ ਕਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ. ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ; ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕੁ. ਸਰਣਿ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੩॥੨੯॥੬੭॥
By Your mercy I have obtained the Lord's Name, O my Lord of the Universe; servant Nanak has come to Your sanctuary. ॥4॥3॥29॥67॥
ਚੋਜੀ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ. ਚੋਜੀ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਿਆਰਿਆ; ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਚੋਜੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
Playful, O my Lord of the Universe; playful, O my Beloved — my Lord God is wondrous and playful.
ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ. ਕਾਨੑੁ ਉਪਾਇਦਾ. ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿਦਾ; ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ. ਗੋਪੀ ਖੋਜੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
The Lord Himself created Krishna, O my Lord of the Universe; the Lord Himself is the milkmaid who seeks Him.
ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਸਭ ਘਟ ਭੋਗਦਾ, ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ; ਆਪੇ ਰਸੀਆ ਭੋਗੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
The Lord Himself enjoys every heart, O my Lord of the Universe; He Himself is the enjoyer and the ravisher.
ਹਰਿ ਸੁਜਾਣੁ. ਨ ਭੁਲਈ, ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ; ਆਪੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਜੋਗੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
The Lord is all-wise; He is not deceived, O my Lord of the Universe; He Himself is the True Guru, the yogi. ॥1॥
ਆਪੇ ਜਗਤੁ ਉਪਾਇਦਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿਦਾ; ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਖੇਲੈ. ਬਹੁ ਰੰਗੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
He Himself created the world, O my Lord of the Universe; the Lord Himself plays in so many ways.
ਇਕਨਾ ਭੋਗ ਭੋਗਾਇਦਾ. ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ; ਇਕਿ ਨਗਨ ਫਿਰਹਿ. ਨੰਗ ਨੰਗੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
Some He makes enjoy pleasures, O my Lord of the Universe, while others wander about naked, utterly bare.
ਆਪੇ ਜਗਤੁ ਉਪਾਇਦਾ. ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿਦਾ; ਹਰਿ ਦਾਨੁ ਦੇਵੈ ਸਭ ਮੰਗੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
He Himself created the world, O my Lord of the Universe; the Lord gives His gifts to all who ask.
ਭਗਤਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਆਧਾਰੁ ਹੈ. ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ; ਹਰਿ ਕਥਾ ਮੰਗਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਚੰਗੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
The Name is the support of His devotees, O my Lord of the Universe; they ask only for the Lord's sublime discourse. ॥2॥
ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਾਇਦਾ. ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ; ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਾ ਲੋਚ ਮਨਿ ਪੂਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
The Lord Himself inspires His devotees to worship Him, O my Lord of the Universe; the Lord fulfils the longing in the minds of His devotees.
ਆਪੇ ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿਦਾ; ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ. ਨਹੀ ਦੂਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
He Himself pervades the water and the land, O my Lord of the Universe; He is all-pervading, not far away.
ਹਰਿ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਹੈ. ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿਦਾ; ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਭਰਪੂਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
The Lord Himself is within and without, O my Lord of the Universe; the Lord Himself pervades everywhere.
ਹਰਿ ਆਤਮ ਰਾਮੁ ਪਸਾਰਿਆ. ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ; ਹਰਿ ਵੇਖੈ ਆਪਿ ਹਦੂਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
The Lord, the Supreme Soul, has spread out the creation, O my Lord of the Universe; the Lord Himself, ever present, watches over it. ॥3॥
ਹਰਿ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਵਾਜਾ ਪਉਣੁ ਹੈ. ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ; ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਵਜਾਏ ਤਿਉ ਵਾਜੈ ਜੀਉ ॥
Within all, the Lord is the breath that plays the instrument, O my Lord of the Universe; as the Lord Himself plays it, so it sounds.
ਹਰਿ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਹੈ, ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ; ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਗਾਜੈ ਜੀਉ ॥
Within all is the treasure of the Lord's Name, O my Lord of the Universe; through the Guru's Word, the Lord God is revealed.
ਆਪੇ ਸਰਣਿ ਪਵਾਇਦਾ. ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ; ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤ ਜਨਾ ਰਾਖੁ ਲਾਜੈ ਜੀਉ ॥
He Himself leads us to His sanctuary, O my Lord of the Universe; O Lord, You preserve the honour of Your devotees.
175: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਮਿਲੁ ਸੰਗਤੀ. ਮੇਰੇ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ; ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ. ਨਾਮ ਸਿਧਿ ਕਾਜੈ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੪॥੩੦॥੬੮॥
By great good fortune, join the holy company, O my Lord of the Universe; servant Nanak, through the Name one's affairs are resolved. ॥4॥4॥30॥68॥
ਮੈ. ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੈ ਹਰਿ; ਬਿਰਹੁ ਲਗਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥
The Lord has instilled in me a longing for the Lord's Name.
ਮੇਰਾ. ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮਿਤੁ ਮਿਲੈ; ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥
Only if my Friend, the Lord God, meets me shall I find peace.
ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਜੀਵਾ; ਮੇਰੀ ਮਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥
Beholding my Lord God, I live, O my mother.
ਮੇਰਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਖਾ; ਹਰਿ ਭਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
The Name is my friend, and the Lord my brother. ॥1॥
ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹੁ ਸੰਤ ਜੀਉ; ਮੇਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇਰੇ ਜੀਉ ॥
O dear saints, sing the praises of my Lord God.
ਜਪਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜੀਉ; ਭਾਗ ਵਡੇਰੇ ਜੀਉ ॥
Facing the Guru, chant the Name, and great good fortune awakens.
ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ; ਜੀਉ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਰੇ ਜੀਉ ॥
The Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is my soul and my breath of life.
ਫਿਰਿ ਬਹੁੜਿ; ਨ ਭਵਜਲ ਫੇਰੇ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
I shall not have to cross the terrifying world-ocean again. ॥2॥
ਕਿਉ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਵੇਖਾ; ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਚਾਉ ਜੀਉ ॥
How shall I behold my Lord God? My mind and body long for Him.
ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲਹੁ ਸੰਤ ਜੀਉ; ਮਨਿ ਲਗਾ ਭਾਉ ਜੀਉ ॥
Unite me with the Lord, O dear saints; my mind is in love with Him.
ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਪਾਈਐ; ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਰਾਉ ਜੀਉ ॥
Through the Guru's Word, the Beloved Lord King is found.
By great good fortune, chant the Name. ॥3॥
ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਵਡੜੀ; ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਆਸਾ ਜੀਉ ॥
Within my mind and body is a great longing for God, the Lord of the Universe.
ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲਹੁ ਸੰਤ ਜੀਉ; ਗੋਵਿਦ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪਾਸਾ ਜੀਉ ॥
Unite me with the Lord, O dear saints; God, the Lord of the Universe, is close to me.
ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਤਿ; ਨਾਮੁ ਸਦਾ ਪਰਗਾਸਾ ਜੀਉ ॥
Through the True Guru's teaching, the Name is ever revealed.
ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ. ਪੂਰਿਅੜੀ; ਮਨਿ ਆਸਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੫॥੩੧॥੬੯॥
Servant Nanak, the hope of the mind is fulfilled. ॥4॥5॥31॥69॥
ਮੇਰਾ. ਬਿਰਹੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ; ਤਾ ਜੀਵਾ ਜੀਉ ॥
Only if I meet my Beloved, the Name, from whom I am separated, can I live.
ਮਨ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ; ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਲੀਵਾ ਜੀਉ ॥
Within the mind is the ambrosial nectar; through the Guru's teaching I take in the Lord.
ਮਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਤੜਾ; ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਸਦਾ ਪੀਵਾ ਜੀਉ ॥
With my mind imbued with the Lord's love, I ever drink the Lord's essence.
Finding the Lord within my mind, I live. ॥1॥
ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮੁ ਲਗਾ; ਹਰਿ ਬਾਣੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
The arrow of the Lord's love has pierced my mind and body.
ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਮਿਤ੍ਰੁ; ਹਰਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਸੁਜਾਣੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
The Lord, the all-wise Being, is my Beloved and Friend.
ਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲੇ ਸੰਤ; ਹਰਿ ਸੁਘੜੁ ਸੁਜਾਣੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
The Holy Guru unites one with the accomplished, all-wise Lord.
I am a sacrifice to the Name. ॥2॥
ਹਉ. ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਜਣੁ; ਹਰਿ ਮੀਤੁ ਦਸਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥
I ask for news of the Lord, Har, Har, my Companion and Friend.
ਹਰਿ ਦਸਹੁ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਜੀ; ਹਰਿ ਖੋਜੁ ਪਵਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥
Tell me of the Lord, O dear saints; I am searching for Him.
ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਤੁਠੜਾ ਦਸੇ; ਹਰਿ ਪਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥
When the True Guru, pleased, shows Him to me, I find the Lord.
Through the Lord's Name, I merge in the Name. ॥3॥
ਮੈ ਵੇਦਨ ਪ੍ਰੇਮੁ; ਹਰਿ ਬਿਰਹੁ ਲਗਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥
I feel the pain of love; I long for the Lord.
ਗੁਰ ਸਰਧਾ ਪੂਰਿ; ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਈ ਜੀਉ ॥
O Guru, fulfil my faith, that I may place the ambrosial nectar in my mouth.
ਹਰਿ ਹੋਹੁ ਦਇਆਲੁ; ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈ ਜੀਉ ॥
O Lord, be merciful, that I may meditate on the Lord's Name.
Servant Nanak has obtained the essence of the Lord. ॥4॥6॥20॥18॥32॥70॥
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
ਕਿਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਕੁਸਲੁ ਹੋਤ; ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ॥
How can there be happiness, O my brother?
ਕਿਉ ਪਾਈਐ; ਹਰਿ ਰਾਮ ਸਹਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
How can the Lord, our Help and Support, be found? ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਕੁਸਲੁ ਨ; ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਮੇਰੀ ਸਭ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
There is no happiness in owning a house, or in thinking all Maya is mine,
nor in lofty mansions and beautiful shade.
In false greed, one wastes this human life. ॥1॥
176: One is pleased at the sight of elephants and horses,
assembles armies, and keeps ministers and royal servants;
but the rope of ego is around his neck, the noose. ॥2॥
One may rule in all ten directions,
revel in pleasures and enjoy many women —
but he is like a king who is a beggar in his dream. ॥3॥
ਏਕੁ ਕੁਸਲੁ; ਮੋ ਕਉ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਬਤਾਇਆ ॥
The True Guru has shown me the one true happiness:
ਹਰਿ ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰੇ; ਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਿਆ ਭਗਤਾ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
whatever the Lord does is pleasing to the Lord's devotees.
Servant Nanak, subduing ego, they merge in Him. ॥4॥
ਇਨਿ ਬਿਧਿ ਕੁਸਲ ਹੋਤ; ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ॥
This is the way to find happiness, O my brother;
ਇਉ ਪਾਈਐ; ਹਰਿ ਰਾਮ ਸਹਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ਦੂਜਾ ॥
in this way, the Lord, our Help and Support, is found. ॥1॥ Second Rahao ॥
ਕਿਉ ਭ੍ਰਮੀਐ; ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਕਿਸ ਕਾ ਹੋਈ ॥
Why wander in doubt? What is there to doubt,
ਜਾ ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ; ਰਵਿਆ ਸੋਈ ॥
when He is pervading the water, the land and the sky?
The Guru-facing are saved, while the self-willed lose their honour. ॥1॥
The one whom the merciful Lord Himself protects —
ਤਿਸੁ; ਨਹੀ ਦੂਜਾ ਕੋ ਪਹੁਚਨਹਾਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
no one else can equal him. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
The One Infinite Lord pervades all.
ਤਾ ਤੂੰ ਸੁਖਿ ਸੋਉ; ਹੋਇ ਅਚਿੰਤਾ ॥
Then sleep in peace, free of anxiety.
ਓਹੁ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਜਾਣੈ; ਜੋ ਵਰਤੰਤਾ ॥੨॥
The self-willed, who thirst for duality, are spiritually dead.
ਬਹੁ ਜੋਨੀ ਭਵਹਿ; ਧੁਰਿ ਕਿਰਤਿ ਲਿਖਿਆਸਾ ॥
They wander through many births, according to the destiny of their past deeds.
As they sow, so shall they eat. ॥3॥
Beholding His Blessed Vision, the mind blossoms;
everywhere I see the light of God.
ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ; ਹਰਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਆਸਾ ॥੪॥੨॥੭੧॥
The Lord fulfils the hopes of servant Nanak. ॥4॥2॥71॥
In so many births you were a worm and a moth;
in so many births an elephant, a fish and a deer;
in so many births a bird and a snake;
in so many births you were yoked as a horse and an ox. ॥1॥
Meet the Lord of the Universe; now is the time to meet Him.
After so very long, you have obtained this human body. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
In so many births you were made rocks and mountains;
in so many births you were miscarried in the womb;
in so many births you were created as plants;
you were made to wander through the 8.4 million species. ॥2॥
You have obtained this human birth; in the holy company
ਕਰਿ ਸੇਵਾ; ਭਜੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ॥
serve, and meditate on the Lord, Har, Har, through the Guru's teaching.
If you die (to self) while yet alive, you shall be accepted in His court. ॥3॥
ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਹੋਆ; ਸੁ ਤੁਝ ਤੇ ਹੋਗੁ ॥
Whatever has happened, and whatever shall happen, comes from You.
No one else is able to do anything.
We meet You only when You unite us with Yourself.
ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ; ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ॥੪॥੩॥੭੨॥
Says Nanak, then one sings the praises of the Lord, Har, Har. ॥4॥3॥72॥
In the field of deeds (the human body), sow the Name,
and your work shall be fulfilled.
You shall obtain the fruit, and the fear of death shall be dispelled,
ਨਿਤ ਗਾਵਹਿ; ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਜਾਸ ॥੧॥
if you ever sing the glorious praises of the Lord, Har, Har. ॥1॥
ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ; ਅੰਤਰਿ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
Enshrine the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, deep within your heart,
and quickly resolve your affairs. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Be ever alert to your God;
then you shall be honoured in His court.
177: Give up all your arguments and cleverness,
and fall at the feet of the holy. ॥2॥
ਸਰਬ ਜੀਅ ਹਹਿ; ਜਾ ਕੈ ਹਾਥਿ ॥
The One in whose hands all beings are,
ਕਦੇ ਨ ਵਿਛੁੜੈ; ਸਭ ਕੈ ਸਾਥਿ ॥
who is never separated from them, and is with all —
ਉਪਾਵ ਛੋਡਿ; ਗਹੁ ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਓਟ ॥
abandon your own efforts and grasp His support;
in an instant you shall be released. ॥3॥
ਸਦਾ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਕਰਿ; ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਜਾਣੁ ॥
Know that He is always near.
ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਆਗਿਆ; ਸਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਨੁ ॥
Through the Guru's Word, eradicate self-conceit.
ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ; ਨਾਨਕ ਜਪਿ ਜਾਪੁ ॥੪॥੪॥੭੩॥
O Nanak, chant and meditate on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ॥4॥4॥73॥
The Guru's Word is eternal and imperishable.
ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਨਿ; ਕਟੀ ਜਮ ਫਾਸੀ ॥
Through the Guru's Word, the noose of death is cut.
ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਬਚਨੁ; ਜੀਅ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ॥
The Guru's Word is always with the soul.
ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਨਿ; ਰਚੈ ਰਾਮ ਕੈ ਰੰਗਿ ॥੧॥
Through the Guru's Word, one is immersed in the love of the Lord. ॥1॥
ਜੋ ਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਆ; ਸੁ. ਮਨ ਕੈ ਕਾਮਿ ॥
Whatever the Guru gives is of use to the mind.
ਸੰਤ ਕਾ ਕੀਆ; ਸਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਨਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Accept what the Holy Guru does as true. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
The Guru's Word is unshakeable and indestructible.
ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਨਿ; ਕਟੇ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਭੇਦ ॥
Through the Guru's Word, doubt and prejudice are cut away.
ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਬਚਨੁ; ਕਤਹੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
The Guru's Word never goes in vain.
ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਨਿ; ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ॥੨॥
Through the Guru's Word, one sings the Lord's praises. ॥2॥
ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਬਚਨੁ; ਜੀਅ ਕੈ ਸਾਥ ॥
The Guru's Word stays with the soul.
ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਬਚਨੁ; ਅਨਾਥ ਕੋ ਨਾਥ ॥
The Guru's Word is the master of the masterless.
ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਨਿ; ਨਰਕਿ ਨ ਪਵੈ ॥
Through the Guru's Word, one does not fall into hell.
ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਨਿ; ਰਸਨਾ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਰਵੈ ॥੩॥
Through the Guru's Word, the tongue savours the ambrosial nectar. ॥3॥
The Guru's Word is manifest in the world.
ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਨਿ; ਨ ਆਵੈ ਹਾਰਿ ॥
Through the Guru's Word, one does not lose (the game of life).
The person to whom the Lord Himself is merciful —
O Nanak, the True Guru is ever kind to him. ॥4॥5॥74॥
He who made the jewel (of the human body) from clay,
ਗਰਭ ਮਹਿ ਰਾਖਿਆ; ਜਿਨਿ ਕਰਿ ਜਤਨੁ ॥
who carefully protected you in the womb,
who gave you honour and glory —
ਤਿਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ; ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਧਿਆਈ ॥੧॥
meditate on that God twenty-four hours a day. ॥1॥
O beautiful Lord, may I obtain the dust of the feet of the holy,
ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ; ਅਪੁਨਾ ਖਸਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
and meeting the Guru, meditate on my Master. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
He who made me, a fool, into a fine speaker,
who made me, the unaware, aware,
by whose grace I have obtained the nine treasures —
ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ; ਮਨ ਤੇ. ਬਿਸਰਤ ਨਾਹੀ ॥੨॥
that God is never forgotten by my mind. ॥2॥
He who gave a place to the placeless,
who gave honour to the dishonoured,
who has fulfilled all my hopes —
I remember Him day and night, with every breath and every morsel. ॥3॥
By His grace the noose of Maya is cut away;
by the Guru's grace, the sweet nectar (of Maya) is now known to be bitter poison.
ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ; ਇਸ ਤੇ ਕਿਛੁ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
Says Nanak, nothing is in the hands of this mortal;
I praise the Lord, the Protector. ॥4॥6॥75॥
ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਿ; ਨਾਹੀ ਭਉ ਸੋਗੁ ॥
In His sanctuary there is no fear or sorrow.
ਉਸ ਤੇ ਬਾਹਰਿ; ਕਛੂ ਨ ਹੋਗੁ ॥
I have renounced cleverness and the vice of relying on my own strength and intellect.
He is the Protector of His servant. ॥1॥
ਜਪਿ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ; ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਰੰਗਿ ॥
Meditate, O my mind, on the Lord's Name with love.
ਘਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ; ਤੇਰੈ ਸਦ ਸੰਗਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
At home and away, He is always with you. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਟੇਕ; ਮਨੈ ਮਹਿ ਰਾਖੁ ॥
Keep His support in your mind.
178: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ; ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਖੁ ॥
Taste the ambrosial essence of the Guru's Word.
Tell me, of what use are other efforts?
In His mercy, He Himself preserves our honour. ॥2॥
What is man? Tell me, what power has he?
All the tumult of Maya is false.
The Master is the Doer, the Cause of causes.
He knows the inner state of every heart. ॥3॥
Of all peace, this is the true peace:
take the Guru's teaching into your mind.
ਜਾ ਕਉ; ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ॥
One who is lovingly attuned to the Lord's Name —
says Nanak, he is blessed and very fortunate. ॥4॥7॥76॥
Listening to the Lord's discourse, they washed away their filth.
They became utterly pure and obtained a mountain of peace.
By great good fortune they found the holy company,
and came to love the Supreme Lord God. ॥1॥
ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ; ਜਨੁ ਤਾਰਿਓ ॥
Chanting the Lord's Name, Har, Har, His servant is carried across.
ਅਗਨਿ ਸਾਗਰੁ; ਗੁਰਿ. ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰਿਓ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
The Guru has carried him across the ocean of fire. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Singing His praises, their minds are cooled,
and the sins of birth after birth are washed away.
They have seen all treasures within their own minds;
why should they now go out searching? ॥2॥
the labour of His servant is fulfilled.
Cutting their bonds, He makes them His own slaves.
Remembering, remembering, remembering the Treasure of virtue (they merge in Him). ॥3॥
The One is in the mind, and the One is in all places.
The Perfect Lord is pervading everywhere.
The Perfect Guru has dispelled all doubt.
Remembering the Lord, O Nanak, one finds peace. ॥4॥8॥77॥
Those who died before are forgotten;
ਜੋ ਉਬਰੇ; ਸੇ ਬੰਧਿ ਲਕੁ ਖਰੇ ॥
those who survive gird up their loins (to gather wealth).
In the affairs in which those were entangled,
ਉਨ ਤੇ ਦੁਗੁਣ; ਦਿੜੀ ਉਨ ਮਾਏ ॥੧॥
these become entangled twice as tightly with Maya. ॥1॥
ਓਹ ਬੇਲਾ; ਕਛੁ. ਚੀਤਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
One does not remember that time (of death) at all;
one clings to what shall perish. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
The body of the fool is bound by hopes;
he is entangled in lust, anger and attachment.
The Righteous Judge stands over his head,
yet, thinking it sweet, he eats the poison (of Maya). ॥2॥
"I shall bind him, I shall take revenge on him;
who dares to set foot on my land?
I am learned, I am clever and wise" —
the ignorant one does not recognise his Creator. ॥3॥
He Himself knows His own state and extent.
ਕਿਆ ਕੋ ਕਹੈ; ਕਿਆ ਆਖਿ ਵਖਾਨੈ ॥
What can anyone say? How can anyone describe Him?
ਜਿਤੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਲਾਵਹਿ; ਤਿਤੁ ਤਿਤੁ ਲਗਨਾ ॥
Whatever You attach us to, to that we are attached.
Everyone begs for his own good (from You). ॥4॥
Everything is Yours; You are the Creator.
You have no end or limit.
Please give Your servant this gift,
that Nanak may never forget the Name. ॥5॥9॥78॥
Through all sorts of efforts, one is not released;
through great cleverness, the burden only grows.
Serving the Lord with pure love,
one goes to God's court with honour. ॥1॥
179: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਗਹੁ; ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਕਾ ਓਲਾ ॥
O my mind, hold fast to the support of the Lord's Name,
ਤੁਝੈ. ਨ ਲਾਗੈ; ਤਾਤਾ ਝੋਲਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
and not even a hot wind shall touch you. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
As a boat (saves one) in the terrifying ocean,
as a lamp gives light in the darkness,
as fire takes away the pain of cold,
so, chanting the Name, the mind finds peace. ॥2॥
ਉਤਰਿ ਜਾਇ; ਤੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਪਿਆਸ ॥
The thirst of your mind shall be quenched,
and all your hopes shall be fulfilled.
Facing the Guru, chant the Ambrosial Name, O friend. ॥3॥
Only that person obtains the medicine of the Name
to whom the Lord, in His mercy, has it given.
ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ; ਜਾ ਕੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਵਸੈ ॥
One in whose heart the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, dwells —
O Nanak, his pain and sorrow run away. ॥4॥10॥79॥
ਬਹੁਤੁ ਦਰਬੁ ਕਰਿ; ਮਨੁ ਨ ਅਘਾਨਾ ॥
Gathering much wealth, the mind is not satisfied.
Beholding many beauties, it is not content.
One is entangled with children and spouse, thinking them one's own.
That (beauty) perishes, and they become heaps of ashes. ॥1॥
Without meditating on the Lord, I see them crying out in pain.
ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਤਨੁ. ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਧਨੁ; ਮਾਇਆ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Cursed is the body and cursed is the wealth of those imbued with Maya. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਜਿਉ ਬਿਗਾਰੀ ਕੈ ਸਿਰਿ; ਦੀਜਹਿ ਦਾਮ ॥
As money is placed on the head of a hired labourer —
ਓਇ ਖਸਮੈ ਕੈ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ; ਉਨ ਦੂਖ ਸਹਾਮ ॥
it goes to the master's house, and he suffers only the pain (of carrying it) —
as one sits as a king in a dream,
but when he opens his eyes, it was all in vain — ॥2॥
as a watchman guards another's field —
ਖੇਤੁ ਖਸਮ ਕਾ; ਰਾਖਾ ਉਠਿ ਜਾਏ ॥
the field belongs to its owner, and the watchman gets up and leaves;
he suffers for the sake of that field,
ਤਿਸ ਕੈ ਪਾਲੈ; ਕਛੂ ਨ ਪੜੈ ॥੩॥
but nothing comes into his hands. ॥3॥
ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਰਾਜੁ; ਤਿਸੈ ਕਾ ਸੁਪਨਾ ॥
The dream belongs to the One to whom the kingdom belongs.
ਜਿਨਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਦੀਨੀ; ਤਿਨਿ ਲਾਈ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ॥
He who gave Maya has also instilled the craving for it.
He Himself destroys, and He Himself fulfils.
Nanak offers his prayer to God. ॥4॥11॥80॥
ਬਹੁ ਰੰਗ ਮਾਇਆ; ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਪੇਖੀ ॥
I have seen Maya, in her many colours, in so many ways.
With pen and paper, I have written clever things.
I have seen what it is to be a chief, a king and a lord,
but the mind is not satisfied by them. ॥1॥
ਸੋ ਸੁਖੁ ਮੋ ਕਉ; ਸੰਤ ਬਤਾਵਹੁ ॥
Show me that peace, O saints,
which will quench my thirst and satisfy my mind. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Horses swift as the wind, elephants to ride,
perfumes and sandalwood, a bed with a beautiful woman,
actors in dramas, songs sung in the arena —
ਤਾ ਮਹਿ; ਮਨਿ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
in these, the mind finds no contentment. ॥2॥
A throne at court, decorations and carpets,
all sorts of fruits, beautiful gardens,
the thrill of the chase, the pleasures of kings —
the mind is not made happy by such deceptive diversions. ॥3॥
In their mercy, the saints have told me the Truth,
and so I have obtained this bliss, the source of all peace:
in the holy company, sing the praises of the Lord.
Says Nanak, this is obtained by great good fortune. ॥4॥
ਜਾ ਕੈ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ; ਸੋਈ ਸੁਹੇਲਾ ॥
One who has the wealth of the Lord is truly at ease.
ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ; ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਮੇਲਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ਦੂਜਾ ॥੧੨॥੮੧॥
By God's grace, one joins the holy company. ॥1॥ Second Rahao ॥12॥81॥
180: The mortal thinks, "This body is mine,"
and clings to it again and again.
Entangled in the noose of children, spouse and household,
ਹੋਨੁ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ; ਰਾਮ ਕੇ ਦਾਸਾ ॥੧॥
one cannot become the slave of the Lord. ॥1॥
ਕਵਨ ਸੁ ਬਿਧਿ; ਜਿਤੁ ਰਾਮ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ॥
What is that way by which one may sing the praises of the Lord?
ਕਵਨ ਸੁ ਮਤਿ; ਜਿਤੁ ਤਰੈ ਇਹ ਮਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
What is that understanding by which one may cross over this Maya? ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
What is for his good, he thinks to be bad.
If someone tells him the truth, he regards it as poison.
He does not know victory from defeat.
This is the way of the faithless world. ॥2॥
The madman drinks the deadly poison,
and thinks the Ambrosial Name bitter.
He does not even go near the holy company,
and wanders through the 8.4 million species. ॥3॥
The birds are caught in the one net (of Maya);
ਰਸਿ ਰਸਿ ਭੋਗ ਕਰਹਿ; ਬਹੁ ਰੰਗੀ ॥
they indulge in pleasures of many kinds.
Says Nanak, the one to whom the Lord is merciful —
the Perfect Guru has cut away his noose. ॥4॥13॥82॥
By Your grace, the path is found.
By God's grace, one meditates on the Name.
By God's grace, one is released from bondage.
By Your grace, ego is broken. ॥1॥
As You attach us, so we are attached to Your service.
ਹਮ ਤੇ. ਕਛੂ ਨ ਹੋਵੈ; ਦੇਵ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
By ourselves we can do nothing, O Divine Lord. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
If it pleases You, I sing the Word of Your praise.
If it pleases You, I speak the Truth.
If it pleases You, the True Guru shows mercy.
All peace, O God, lies in Your kindness. ॥2॥
ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ; ਸੋ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਕਰਮਾ ॥
Whatever pleases You is a pure deed.
ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ; ਸੋ ਸਚੁ ਧਰਮਾ ॥
Whatever pleases You is true righteousness.
ਸਰਬ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਗੁਣ; ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਪਾਸਿ ॥
All treasures and virtues are with You alone.
You are the Master; Your servant prays to You. ॥3॥
ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਇ; ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ॥
Mind and body become pure through the Lord's love.
I find all peace in the holy company.
One whose mind remains imbued with Your Name
regards this as true well-being, O Nanak. ॥4॥14॥83॥
All the other tastes you have tasted (O tongue)
have not quenched your thirst even for a moment.
ਹਰਿ ਰਸ ਕਾ; ਤੂੰ ਚਾਖਹਿ ਸਾਦੁ ॥
If you taste the flavour of the Lord's essence,
tasting it, you shall be wonderstruck. ॥1॥
O dear tongue, drink the ambrosial nectar.
ਇਹ ਰਸ ਰਾਤੀ; ਹੋਇ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Imbued with this essence, you shall be satisfied. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਹੇ ਜਿਹਵੇ; ਤੂੰ ਰਾਮ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ ॥
O tongue, sing the praises of the Lord.
ਨਿਮਖ ਨਿਮਖ; ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਉ ॥
Each and every moment, meditate on the Lord, Har, Har, Har.
Do not listen to anything else, nor go anywhere else.
The holy company is found by great good fortune. ॥2॥
Twenty-four hours a day, O tongue, dwell upon
the unfathomable Supreme Lord God, the Master.
Here and hereafter, you shall be happy forever.
Singing the Lord's praises, the tongue becomes priceless. ॥3॥
The vegetation blossoms, the trees bear fruit and flowers,
ਇਹ ਰਸ ਰਾਤੀ; ਬਹੁਰਿ. ਨ ਛੋਡੇ ॥
but the one imbued with this essence never abandons it.
ਆਨ ਨ ਰਸ ਕਸ; ਲਵੈ ਨ ਲਾਈ ॥
No other tastes or flavours can equal it,
ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ; ਗੁਰ ਭਏ ਹੈ ਸਹਾਈ ॥੪॥੧੫॥੮੪॥
says Nanak, for one whose helper the Guru has become. ॥4॥15॥84॥
The mind is the temple, and the body the fence built around it.
